The '''D-1Z prototype bomber''' was a prototype variant of the [[B28 Extinction-class bomber|B28 ''Extinction''-class bomber]] developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which was taken for a test flight during the [[Battle above Lorta]].
